node.title: XR SL-2-RES maximal selected window-divisor count: exact-depth residual <=17n^2/25
node.statement: At each prize row and high band-proper depth, let R_d(u,v) contain the degree-(n-k-d) monic split squarefree divisors E_T|X^n-1 satisfying both top-d window systems, whose reconstructed codeword pair has full joint core exactly H\T, has L_P>=2 under support-wise first-match selection, and survives the generic strip order. Then 25|R_d|<=17n^2. The window lemma identifies this set exactly with N_d. Common-class quotient-periodic, BP-parity, and large sub-depth liveness exclusions are removed only where proved; small-scale mixed-class and aperiodic systems remain. Raw affine divisors without maximality/selection are explicitly outside the assertion.
